data.contenido:
Nienwu a anwuma nee azɛlɛ ye vi rale a? Na kɛ sɛnzɛne ne, siane nee nwɔlɔra, yɛɛ akee ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, zi rale ɛ? Baebolo ne fa nyelebɛnloa mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la maa mekɛ mɔɔ ɔka kɛ Nyamenle a bɔle bɛ la. Ɔti yɛ buluku ne fa Baebolo nu edwɛkɛ mɔɔ fane ninyɛnebɔlɛ nwo la a bɔ ɔ bo a.

Yɛsukoa kɛ, Nyamenle abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lumua la le sunsum nu menli mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la. Bɛle anwumabɔvolɛma. Noko bɛbɔle azɛlɛ ne bɛmanle menli mɔɔ le kɛ yɛdayɛ la. Yemɔti Nyamenle bɔle nrenya nee raalɛ mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ bɛ Adam nee Yive la na ɔvale bɛ ɔguale tola kɛnlɛma bie anu. Noko bɛandie Nyamenle ɔti adenle mɔɔ bɛlɛ bɛkɔ zo bɛtɛnla ngoane nu la vile bɛ sa.

Wɔ ɔ muala anu, ɔbɔ ye wɔ Adam ɛbɔlɛ zo toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu Azuyilɛ kpole ne azo la le ɛvolɛ 1,656. Wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu ɛnee nindavoma dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛkɛ. Ɛnee sunsum nu menli mɔɔ ɛnyelɛ ɛnnwu bɛ, Seetan nee ye anwumabɔvolɛ ɛtane ne mɔ, wɔ anwuma. Ɛnee Keen yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma gyɛne dɔɔnwo mɔɔ menli bie mɔɔ lɛ anwosesebɛ ngakyile la boka nwo la, wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Noko ɛnee menli mgbalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo—Ebɛle, Yinɔko nee Nowa. Wɔ Foa KO ne anu yɛbazukoa menli ɛhye mɔ amuala nee edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sisile la anwo debie.

data.titulo: Nyamenle Bɔle Ɔ Bo Bɔle Ninyɛne
data.contenido:
NINYƐNE mgbalɛ mɔɔ yɛlɛ la amuala vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ. Ɔbɔle sɛnzɛne ne kɛ ɔmaa yɛ wienyi alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ siane ne nee nwɔlɔra ne mɔ amaa yɛanyia wienyi aledwolɛ nu. Akee Nyamenle bɔle azɛlɛ ne kɛ yɛdɛnla zolɛ.

Noko tɛ sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, nwɔlɔra ne mɔ yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne a le ninyɛne mɔɔ Nyamenle lumua bɔle a. Ɛze debie mɔɔ lumua la ɔ? Nyamenle lumua bɔle menli mɔɔ le kɛ ɔdaye la. Yɛnnwu menli ɛhye mɔ, kɛmɔ yɛnnwu Nyamenle ala la. Wɔ Baebolo ne anu bɛfɛlɛ menli ɛhye mɔ anwumabɔvolɛma. Nyamenle bɔle anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛ nee ye ɛdɛnla anwuma.

Anwumabɔvolɛ mɔɔ lumua mɔɔ Nyamenle bɔle la le ngakyile. Ɛnee ɔle Nyamenle Ara mɔɔ lumua, na ɔ nee ɔ Ze yɛle gyima. Ɔboale Nyamenle ɔmanle ɔbɔle ninyɛne gyɛne mɔɔ ɛha la amuala. Ɔboale Nyamenle ɔmanle ɔbɔle sɛnzɛne ne, siane ne, nwɔlɔra ne mɔ yɛɛ yɛ azɛlɛ ye.

Ɛnee kɛ azɛlɛ ne de ɛ? Mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee awie biala ɛnrɛhola azɛlɛ ne azo tɛnla. Ɛnee debie biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ne azo kɛ azule tandane ko ala. Noko ɛnee Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ menli tɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔti ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsiezie ninyɛne yeamaa yɛ. Duzu a ɔyɛle a?

Mɔɔ lumua, ɛnee azɛlɛ ne hyia wienyi. Yemɔti Nyamenle manle wienyi vile sɛnzɛne ne anu dale azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔyɛle ɛhye amaa yɛanyia aledwolɛ nee alehyenlɛ. Ɛhye mɔ anzi, Nyamenle manle azɛlɛ vile azule tandane ne anu rale.

Mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee debie biala ɛnle azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɛnee ɔle kɛ nvoninli ne mɔɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Ɛnee ndotolo anzɛɛ mbaka anzɛɛ nane nane ɛnle ɛkɛ. Ɛnee fɛlɛ biala bɔbɔ ɛnle nyevile ne anu. Ɛnee Nyamenle lɛ gyima dɔɔnwo yɛ amaa azɛlɛ ne ayɛ kɛnlɛma kpalɛ kpalɛ yeamaa nane nee menli adɛnla zo.Gyɛlɛmaya 10:12; Kɔlɔsaema 1:15-17; Mɔlebɛbo 1:1-10. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛke la! Nea kɛ debie biala si de kɛnlɛma la! Nea ndile nee mbaka ne mɔ, ndotolo nee nane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Asoo ɛnwu ɛzonle ne nee awenade ne mɔ?

Kɛ tola kɛnlɛma ɛhye zi rale ɛ? Aa, maa yɛnlea kɛ Nyamenle zi zieziele azɛlɛ ne manle yɛ la.

Mɔɔ lumua la, Nyamenle manle ndile fifile hedale azɛlɛ ne anye. Na Nyamenle bɔle mbaka ngyikyi nee mgbole yɛɛ ndile ngakyile kɔsɔɔti. Ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ fifi la boa maa azɛlɛ ne yɛ kɛnlɛma. Noko bɛyɛ dɔɔnwo bɛtɛla zɔhane. Bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo maa yɛ aleɛ mɔɔ yɛ fɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ a.

Akee Nyamenle bɔle fɛlɛ guale nzule nu yɛɛ nloma kɛ bɛdu bɛluolua anwomanyunlu. Ɔbɔle ahwea nee ahusu yɛɛ mgbɔnwɔ; nane mgbole nee nane ngyikyi. Duzu nane a wɔ wɔ sua nu a? Asoo ɔnle kɛ yɛmaa yɛ nye die kɛ Nyamenle ɛbɔ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛmaa yɛ la ɔ?

Awieleɛ kolaa ne, Nyamenle zieziele azɛlɛ ne azo ɛleka ko kɛnlɛma kpalɛ. Ɔvɛlɛle ɛkɛ ne Yidɛn tola. Ɛnee ɔle kɛnlɛma bɔkɔɔ. Ɛnee debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la le kɛnlɛma. Na ɛnee Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ azɛlɛ ne amuala yɛ kɛ tola kɛnlɛma ɛhye mɔɔ yeyɛ la pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Na nea tola ɛhye nvoninli ne bieko. Ɛze debie mɔɔ Nyamenle nwunle kɛ bie ɛnle ɛkɛ ne la ɔ? Maa yɛnlea ɛ.Mɔlebɛbo 1:11-25; 2:8, 9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

DUZU a le ngakyile wɔ nvoninli ɛhye anu a? Nyɛɛ, menli mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɔ. Bɛmɛ a le nrenya nee raalɛ mɔɔ lumua a. Nwane a bɔle bɛ a? Nyamenle ɔ. Ɛze ye duma ɔ? Yemɔ a le Gyihova. Na bɛravɛlɛle nrenya ne nee raalɛ ne Adam nee Yive.

Kɛ Gyihova Nyamenle bɔle Adam la ɛne. Ɔvale azɛlɛ nwo ndɛtɛlɛ na ɔvale ɔnwonle sonlabaka mɔɔ di munli, sonla nrenya sonlabaka. Akee ɔliele ngoane ɛnwomenle ɔguale sonla ne abonyi nu, na Adam rale ngoane nu.

Gyihova Nyamenle manle Adam gyima. Ɔzele Adam kɛ ɔtoto nane ngakyile ne mɔ amuala aluma. Ɔbayɛ kɛ Adam guale ɔ nye aze nleanle nane ne mɔ mekɛ tendenle amaa yeahola yeava duma mɔɔ fɛta la yeamaa bɛ nuhua ko biala. Mɔɔ Adam ɛlɛtoto nane ne mɔ aluma la ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔnwunle debie. Ɛze deɛ holɛ ko ɔ?

Ɛnee nane ne mɔ amuala lua ye nwiɔ nwiɔ. Ɛnee papa ɛzonle nee mame ɛzonle wɔ ɛkɛ, yɛɛ papa awenade nee mame awenade wɔ ɛkɛ. Noko ɛnee Adam ɛnlɛ awie mɔɔ bayɛ ye bokavolɛ a. Yemɔti Gyihova manle Adam lafele kpole bie, na ɔyele ɔ nvenle foa bowule ko. Gyihova vale bowule ɛhye bɔle raalɛ manle Adam, na ɔrayɛle ɔ ye.

Nea anyelielɛ mɔɔ Adam nyianle ye a! Na suzu anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɔbahola yeara ye kɛ Yive nyianle ye kɛ bɛvale ye bɛdole tola kɛnlɛma zɛhae anu la anwo nea! Ɛnee akee bɛkola bɛwo mralɛ na bɛbɔ nu bɛtɛnla anyelielɛ nu.

Ɛnee Gyihova kpondɛ kɛ Adam nee Yive tɛnla aze dahuu. Ɛnee ɔkpondɛ kɛ bɛmaa azɛlɛ ne azo amuala kɛnlɛma yɛ kɛ Yidɛn tola ne la. Nea anyelielɛ mɔɔ ɔbahola yeara ye kɛ Adam nee Yive nyianle ye mekɛ mɔɔ bɛdwenledwenle ɛhye ɛyɛlɛ nwo la! Asoo anrɛɛ ɛbahulo kɛ ɛ nee bɛ kɛbɔ nu kɛyɛ azɛlɛ ne tola kɛnlɛma ɔ? Noko Adam nee Yive anyelielɛ ne andɛnla ɛkɛ angyɛ. Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔrale ye zɔ la.Edwɛndolɛ 83:18; Mɔlebɛbo 1:26-31; 2:7-25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Deɛ Mɔɔ Ɔti Bɛ Aako Ne Vile Bɛ Sa La
data.contenido:
NEA mɔɔ ɛlɛsi kɛkala la. Bɛlɛfoa Adam nee Yive bɛavi Yidɛn tola kɛnlɛma ne anu. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti yera ye zɛhae la ɔ?

Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle debie mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ fee la ati ɔ. Na ɛhye ati a Gyihova ɛlɛtwe bɛ nzo a. Asoo ɛze ɛtane mɔɔ Adam nee Yive yɛle a?

Bɛyɛle debie mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle hilele bɛ kɛ bɛmmayɛ la. Nyamenle hanle hilele bɛ kɛ bɛkola bɛdi mbaka ma mɔɔ wɔ tola ne anu la bie. Noko baka ko azo ma yemɔ Nyamenle hanle kɛ bɛmmadi bie, anrɛɛ bɛkɛwu. Ɔvale zɔhane baka ne ɔziele ɛkɛ ne kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne ye deɛ. Na yɛze kɛ ɔnle kpalɛ kɛ awie kɛva debie mɔɔ le awie gyɛne ɛdeɛ la, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Aa, boni a zile a?

Kenle ko mɔɔ ɛnee Yive angome a wɔ tola ne anu la, ɛwɔlɛ bie dendɛle hilele ye. Dwenle nwolɛ nea! Ɔzele Yive kɛ ɔli baka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛha ɛhile bɛ kɛ bɛmmadi zo ma la ma ne bie. Noko, mɔɔ Gyihova bɔle nwɔlɛ la yeambɔ bɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛtendɛ a. Ɔti mɔɔ ɛhye kile la ala a le kɛ awie gyɛne a ɛnee ɛlɛmaa ɛwɔlɛ ne adendɛ a. Ɛnee nwane ɔ?

Tɛ Adam ɔ. Yemɔti ɛnee ɔbayɛ menli mɔɔ ɛnee Gyihova ɛlumua ɛbɔ bɛ mekɛ tendenle kolaa na yeabɔ azɛlɛ ne la anu ko. Menli zɔhane mɔ le anwumabɔvolɛma, na yɛngola yɛnnwu bɛ. Anwumabɔvolɛ ko ɛhye rayɛle anwomemaazo. Ɔbɔle ɔ bo ɔzuzule kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdi tumi kɛ Nyamenle la. Na ɛnee ɔkpondɛ kɛ menli tie ye emomu tɛla kɛ bɛkɛdie Gyihova. Yemɔ a le anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔɔ manle ɛwɔlɛ ne dendɛle la.

Anwumabɔvolɛ ɛhye holale yɛle Yive koasea. Mɔɔ ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ saa ɔdi baka ma ne bie a ɔbayɛ kɛ Nyamenle la, ɔliele ye ɔlile. Ɔti ɔlile, na Adam noko lile bie. Adam nee Yive andie Nyamenle, na yemɔ ati a bɛ tola aako kɛnlɛma ne vile bɛ sa la.

Noko kenlebie Nyamenle banlea kɛ bɛbayɛ azɛlɛ ne amuala azo kɛnlɛma kɛ Yidɛn tola ne la. Amozii yɛbazukoa kɛ ɛbazi wɔahola wɔaboka nwo wɔamaa bɛayɛ ye zɔ la. Noko kɛkala, maa yɛnlea mɔɔ dole Adam nee Yive la.Mɔlebɛbo 2:16, 17; 3:1-13, 24; Yekile 12:⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Asetɛnla Mɔɔ Anu Yɛ Se Bɔle Ɔ Bo
data.contenido:
ADAM nee Yive yiale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ Yidɛn tola ne anzi. Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ na bɛanyia aleɛ. Kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛnwu mbaka ngɛnlɛma mɔɔ so ma la kɛ ɛlɛfifi la, mbowule ngakyile a bɛnwunle bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ a. Ɛhye a zile wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Adam nee Yive andie Nyamenle na bɛangɔ zo bɛanyɛ Ɔ gɔnwo bieko la.

Akee mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye bɔbɔ la, Adam nee Yive bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛwu. Kakye kɛ, Nyamenle bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kɛ saa bɛdi baka ma bie mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la bie a bɛbawu. Kenle ko ne mɔɔ bɛlile bie la bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛwu. Nea koasea mɔɔ bɛyɛle kɛ bɛandie Nyamenle a!

Adam nee Yive wole bɛ mra ne mɔ amuala wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle voanle bɛ vile Yidɛn tola ne anu la anzi. Ɛhye kile kɛ bɛ mra ne mɔ noko banyinyi na bɛawu.

Saa Adam nee Yive diele Gyihova a, yɛɛ anrɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ mra ne mɔ azedɛnlanlɛ bayɛ anyelielɛ a. Anrɛɛ bɛ muala bɛbahola bɛadɛnla aze dahuu wɔ anyelielɛ nu wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo. Anrɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛyɛ kpanyinli, ɔ nwo ɛnrɛdo ye na yeawu bɔbɔ.

Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ menli tɛnla aze dahuu wɔ anyelielɛ nu, na Yebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ kenlebie ɔbayɛ zɔ. Tɛ azɛlɛ ne amuala azo angomekye a bayɛ kɛnlɛma a, na menli kɔsɔɔti banyia kpɔkɛdelɛ kpalɛ noko. Na awie ko biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la nee menli kɔsɔɔti, yɛɛ Nyamenle, banyia agɔnwolɛvalɛ kpalɛ.

Noko ɛnee Yive ɛnle Nyamenle agɔnwo bieko. Yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ ɔwo ɔ mra ne mɔ la, yeanyɛ bɛtɛɛ yeammaa ye. Ɔdele nyane. Tieyɛ mɔɔ yeanyɛ yeammaa Gyihova la vale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo rɛlɛle ye, ɛnlie ɛndo nu ɔ?

Adam nee Yive nyianle mralɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ dɔɔnwo. Mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ ra nrenya mɔɔ lumua la bɛdonle ye duma Keen. Bɛvɛlɛle bɛ ra nrenya mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la Ebɛle. Duzu a dole bɛ a? Ɛze ɔ?Mɔlebɛbo 3:16-23; 4:1, 2; Yekile 21:3, 4. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA Keen nee Ebɛle. Bɛyɛ mgbanyinli. Keen ɛrayɛ ɛyazonlɛnli. Ɔdua abɛlɛ nee atoko mɔ yɛɛ mbaka ma nee ɛbɔ nu ninyɛne ngakyile.

Ebɛle ɛrayɛ mboaneneavolɛ. Ɛnee ɔ nye die kɛ ɔkɛnlea mboane mralɛ. Bɛnyinle bɛyɛle mboane mgbole, ɔti yeangyɛ biala Ebɛle ranyianle mboane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛnee ɔnea zo a.

Kenle ko Keen nee Ebɛle bɔle afɔle manle Nyamenle. Keen vale ye egyinli ne anu aleɛ ne bie rale. Ebɛle noko vale ye boane mɔɔ ɛlɔ kpalɛ la rale. Gyihova anye zɔle Ebɛle nee ye afɔle ne. Na ɔ nye anzɔ Keen nee ye afɔle ne. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔrale ye zɔ la ɔ?

Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ Ebɛle afɔle ɛdeɛ ne le kpalɛ tɛla Keen ɛdeɛ ne la ati ɔ. Yemɔ a le kɛ ɛnee Ebɛle le sonla kpalɛ. Ɛnee ɔkulo Gyihova yɛɛ ɔ diema ne. Noko ɛnee Keen ɛnle sonla kpalɛ; ɛnee ɔngulo ɔ diema ne.



Yemɔti Nyamenle hanle hilele Keen kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔkakyi ye subane.Noko Keen andie. Ɔvale ɛya kpole ɔluakɛ ɛnee Nyamenle kulo Ebɛle kpalɛ la ati. Ɔti Keen zele Ebɛle kɛ: ‘Maa yɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu.’ Wɔ ɛkɛ ne, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne la, Keen bɔle ɔ diema Ebɛle. Ɔbɔle ye kpole ɔmanle ɔholale ye na ɔwule. Asoo ɛhye ɛnle ɛtane kpole mɔɔ Keen yɛle a?

Ɔwɔ nuhua kɛ Ebɛle ɛwu ɛdeɛ, noko Nyamenle tɛkakye ye. Ɛnee Ebɛle le sonla kpalɛ, na Gyihova arɛle ɛnvi sonla zɛhae ɛlɛ. Yemɔti kenlebie Gyihova Nyamenle bava Ebɛle azia ara ngoane nu bieko. Wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne anu, Ebɛle ɛnrɛwu bieko. Ɔbahola yeadɛnla aze wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo dahuu. Asoo ɔnrɛyɛ anyelielɛ kɛ yɛkɛnwu menli mɔɔ le kɛ Ebɛle la ɔ?

Noko Nyamenle anye ɛnlie menli mɔɔ le kɛ Keen la anwo. Ɔti mɔɔ Keen hunle ɔ diema ne wiele la, Nyamenle hwenle ɔ nzo ɔlua ɛvoanlɛ mɔɔ ɔvoanle ye ɔvile ye mbusuama avinli ɔmanle ɔhɔdɛnlanle moamoa la azo. Mɔɔ Keen kɔ ahɔdɛnla azɛlɛ ne foa bie azo la, ɔvale ɔ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ ko ɔhɔle, na ɔrayɛle ɔ ye.

Yeangyɛ Keen nee ɔ ye bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛwo mralɛ. Adam nee Yive amra mrenya nee mraalɛ mɔɔ ɛha la noko gyale bɛ nwo, na bɛdabɛ noko bɛwole mralɛ. Yeangyɛ biala menli dɔɔnwo rale azɛlɛ ne azo. Maa yɛzukoa bie mɔ anwo debie.Mɔlebɛbo 4:2-26; 1 Dwɔn 3:11, 12; Dwɔn 11:25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MƆƆ menli bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛso wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo yɛle ninyɛndane kɛ Keen la. Noko ɛnee bɛ nuhua ko le ngakyile. Yemɔ a le nrenya ɛhye mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yinɔko la. Ɛnee Yinɔko le nrenya mɔɔ ɔ kɛnra yɛ se. Ɛnee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la amuala ɛlɛyɛ ninyɛndane, noko Yinɔko hɔle zolɛ zonlenle Nyamenle. Asoo ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti menli mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛkɛ ne zɔhane mekɛ ne la yɛle ninyɛndane dɔɔnwo zɔhane la ɔ? Dwenle nwolɛ nea, Nwane a manle Adam nee Yive yɛle Nyamenle anwo anzosesebɛ na bɛlile baka ma ne mɔɔ Nyamenle hanle kɛ bɛmmadi la bie a? Ɛhɛe, anwumabɔvolɛ ɛtane bie ɔ. Baebolo ne fɛlɛ ye Seetan. Na ɔlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔbamaa awie biala ayɛ ɛtane.

Kenle ko Gyihova Nyamenle manle Yinɔko hanle edwɛkɛ bie mɔɔ menli ne ɛmkpondɛ kɛ bɛte la ɔhilele bɛ. Yemɔ ɛne: ‘Nyamenle bara arazɛkye ɛtanevolɛma amuala kenlebie.’ Ɔbayɛ kɛ menli ne vale ɛya kpole kɛ bɛdele ɛhye la. Bie a bɛbɔle mɔdenle bɔbɔ kɛ bɛku Yinɔko. Yemɔti ɛnee ɔhyia kɛ Yinɔko si ɔ kɛnra kpalɛ na yeahola yeaha mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛlɛba arayɛ la yeahile menli ne.



Nyamenle ammaa Yinɔko andɛnla aze mekɛ tendenle wɔ ɛtanevolɛma zɔhane avinli. Yinɔko lile ɛvolɛ 365 pɛ. Duzu ati a yɛka kɛ “ɛvolɛ 365 pɛ” a? Ɔluakɛ zɔhane mekɛ ne ɛnee menli te kpɔkɛ kpalɛ ɔti ɛnee bɛtɛnla aze bɛkyɛ kpalɛ bɛtɛla ɛnɛ. Ɛhɛe, Yinɔko ara Mɛtusɛla lile ɛvolɛ 969!

Wɔ Yinɔko ewule nzi, menli ne ɛtaneyɛlɛ yɛle kpole kpalɛ. Baebolo ne ka kɛ ‘ɛtane ngome yile bɛ adwenle nee bɛ ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ,’ na ‘basabasayɛlɛ yɛle kpole kpalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.’

Ɛze debie mɔɔ manle basabasayɛlɛ dɔɔnwo rale azɛlɛ ne azo wɔ zɔhane mekɛ ne la anu ko ɔ? Yemɔ a le kɛ Seetan nyianle adenle fofolɛ mɔɔ ɔdua zo ɔmaa menli yɛ ninyɛndane a. Yɛbazukoa ɛhye anwo debie wɔ mɔɔ doa zo la anu.Mɔlebɛbo 5:21-24, 27; 6:⁠5; Hibuluma 11:⁠5; Dwuudu 14, 15. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

SAA ɛ nee awie ɛlɛba arayia yɛɛ ahenle ne tendenle kpula sua ti zo a, anrɛɛ duzu a bara wɔ adwenle nu a? Sonla zɛhae bayɛ kakanyinli! Mekɛ bie mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la ɛnee kakanyinlima wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Baebolo ne kile kɛ bɛ ze mɔ le anwumabɔvolɛma mɔɔ ɛnee bɛwɔ anwuma a. Noko kɛ ɛhye kola si yɛ zɔ ɛ?

Kakye kɛ, ɛnee Seetan, anwumabɔvolɛ ɛtane ne anye ɛbolo ɛlɛtwehwe edwɛkɛ ara. Ɛnee ɔlɛbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔkɛmaa Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ bɔbɔ kɛyɛ ɛtane. Yeangyɛ, anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ bie bɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛtie Seetan. Bɛgyakyile gyima mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛva ɛmaa bɛ kɛ bɛyɛ wɔ anwuma la. Na bɛrale azɛlɛ ye azo bɛravale sonla nwonane bɛkpolole. Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti bɛyɛle zɔhane la ɔ?

Baebolo ne ka kɛ ɔyɛle zɔ ɔluakɛ Nyamenle mra ɛhye mɔ nwunle azɛlɛ ye azo mraalɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ na ɛnee bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛ nee bɛ tɛnla. Yemɔti bɛrale azɛlɛ ye azo na bɛgyale mraalɛ ɛhye mɔ. Baebolo ne ka kɛ ɛnee ɛhye le ɛtane, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle bɔle anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛdɛnla anwuma.

Mɔɔ anwumabɔvolɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ ye mɔ wole mralɛ la, ɛnee mralɛ ɛhye mɔ le ngakyile. Mɔlebɛbo ne ɛnee bɛnle ngakyile biala. Noko bɛhɔle zo bɛnyinyinle, bɛyɛle mgbole mgbole bie, na bɛ nwo yɛle se kpalɛ kpalɛ, hɔdwule kɛ bɛyɛle kakanyinlima la. Ɛnee kakanyinlima ɛhye mɔ ɛnle menli mgbalɛ. Na ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛle mgbole na bɛ nwo yɛ se la ati, bɛsisile menli. Bɛbɔle mɔdenle kɛ bɛmaa awie biala ayɛ ɛtane kɛ bɛdabɛ la.

Ɛnee Yinɔko ɛwu, noko ɛnee nrenya ko wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo mɔɔ le sonla kpalɛ a. Nrenya ɛhye a le Nowa. Dahuu ɔyɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle kpondɛ kɛ ɔyɛ la.

Kenle ko Nyamenle hanle hilele Nowa kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu kɛ Ɔsɛkye ɛtanevolɛma kɔsɔɔti. Noko ɛnee Nyamenle balie Nowa, ye abusua ne yɛɛ nane nane dɔɔnwo ngoane. Maa yɛnlea kɛ Nyamenle zile yɛle ɛhye la.Mɔlebɛbo 6:1-⁠8; Dwuudu 6. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐNEE Nowa aye ko yɛɛ ɔ mra mrenya nsa. Ɔ mra ne mɔ aluma a le Hyɛm, Ham yɛɛ Gyeefɛte. Na ɛnee mralɛ mrenya nsa ɛhye mɔ ko biala aye ko. Yemɔti ɛnee menli mɔtwɛ a wɔ Nowa abusua ne anu a.

Akee Nyamenle manle Nowa yɛle debie mɔɔ ɔtɛyɛle bie ɛlɛ la. Ɔhanle ɔhilele ye kɛ ɔbobɔ ɛlɛne kpole ko. Ɛnee ɛlɛne ɛhye tɛlɛ kɛ meli la, noko ɛnee ɔle kɛ ɛlɛka tendenle, kpole bie. Nyamenle hanle kɛ: ‘Bobɔ ye nzɛzo nsa, na kyɛ nuhua ekpumgbunli ekpumgbunli.’ Ɛnee Nowa nee ye abusua ne yɛɛ nane ne mɔ, nee aleɛ mɔɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛbahyia la a bahɔ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ anu a.

Nyamenle eza hanle hilele Nowa kɛ ɔbobɔ ɛlɛne ne mɔɔ nzule ɛnrɛhɔ nu a. Nyamenle hanle kɛ: ‘Mebamaa ezule kpole bie adɔ toonwo abu aze, yeazɛkye aleɛabo amuala. Debie anzɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ ɛnle ɛlɛne ne anu la bawu.’

Nowa nee ɔ mra ne mɔ diele Gyihova na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛbobɔ ɛlɛne ne. Na menli mɔɔ ɛha la ɛdeɛ bɛzelele ala. Bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛyɛle ninyɛndane. Mekɛ mɔɔ Nowa hanle mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛlɛba arayɛ la hilele bɛ la, bɛanlie bɛanli. Ɔhyɛle kpalɛ na ɛlɛne ɛbobɔlɛ ne awie ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle kpole kpalɛ. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, wɔ ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo anzi, bɛwiele. Akee Nyamenle hanle hilele Nowa kɛ ɔva nane ne mɔ ɔhɔ ɛlɛne ne anu. Nyamenle hanle kɛ ɔva nane ne bie mɔ nwiɔ, nyinli nee belɛ. Na nane ne bie mɔ ɛdeɛ, Nyamenle hanle hilele Nowa kɛ ɔva nsuu nsuu ɔrɛla. Eza Nyamenle hanle hilele Nowa kɛ ɔva nloma ngakyile ne amuala bie ɔhɔ ɛlɛne ne anu. Nowa yɛle mɔɔ Nyamenle zele ye la pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Ɛhye mɔ anzi, Nowa nee ye abusua ne hɔle ɛlɛne ne anu. Akee Nyamenle dole anlenkɛ ne anu. Nowa nee ye abusua ne hendɛle ɛlɛne ne anu. Fa ye kɛ ɛwɔ ɛlɛne ne anu bie, yɛɛ ɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkendɛ a. Asoo azuyilɛ ne bara amgba kɛmɔ Nyamenle hanle la?Mɔlebɛbo 6:9-22; 7:1-⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MENLI mɔɔ ɛnle ɛlɛne ne anu la hɔle zolɛ bɔle bɛ ɛbɛla kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde ala la. Bɛanlie bɛanli kɛ Azuyilɛ ne bara. Ɔbayɛ kɛ bɛzelele kpole bɛdɛlale alumua ne. Noko yeangyɛ biala bɛgyakyile ɛzelekɛ ne.

Arɛlevilɛ nu ala ezule ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔtɔ. Ɔvi anwuma ɔwolale kɛ asɛɛ bɛlɛwola nzule bɛavi bokiti nu la. Nowa edwɛkɛ ne ɛyɛ nɔhalɛ! Noko ɛnee yeha amozi somaa kɛ awie bieko kɛhɔ ɛlɛne ne anu. Ɛnee Gyihova ɛdo anlenkɛ ne anu kyengyekyengye.

Yeangyɛ biala azule ne vale azɛlɛ ne azo amuala. Nzule ne yɛle azɛlɛ ne anye faanwo kɛ azule mgbole la. Ɔzuhunle mbaka ɔguale na ɔhundole awolɛ mgbole, na ɔyɛle dede dɔɔnwo. Menli ne zulole. Bɛfofole awoka ndendenle. Oo, nea kɛ bɛ kunlu a anrɛɛ bɛdiele Nowa na bɛhɔle ɛlɛne ne anu wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛtole anlenkɛ ne anu la ɛ! Noko ɛnee yeha amozi somaa.

Azule ne hɔle zolɛ yile hɔle anwuma. Ezule dɔle vile anwuma nɔɔzo nee ewiazo kenle 40. Ɔvole awoka ne mɔ azo, na akee ɔhedale awoka ndendenle ne mɔ bɔbɔ azo. Yemɔti kɛmɔ ɛnee Nyamenle ɛha la, menli nee nane mɔɔ ɛnle ɛlɛne ne anu la kɔsɔɔti wule. Noko awie biala mɔɔ wɔ nuhua la nyianle ngoane. Nowa nee ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ yɛle gyima kpalɛ kɛ bɛbobɔle ɛlɛne ne la. Nzule ne manle ɛlɛne ne zo, na ɔtulule nzule ne anye. Na kenle ko, mɔɔ ɛnee ezule ne ɛgyakyi ɛdɔlɛ la, sɛnzɛne ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔfi. Nea kɛnlɛma mɔɔ ɛnee ɔde a! Ɛnee azule faanwo ko ala a la ɛkɛ a. Na debie ko pɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛnwu ye la a le ɛlɛne ne mɔɔ ɛtulu ɔ nye la.

Kakanyinlima ne mɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ bieko. Bɛnle ɛkɛ bieko na bɛasisi menli. Bɛ muala bɛwu, bɛ nee bɛ nli mɔ yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma mɔɔ ɛha la. Na duzu a dole bɛ ze mɔ a?

Kakanyinlima ne mɔ bɛ ze mɔ ɛnle menli kɛ yɛdayɛ la. Bɛle anwumabɔvolɛma mɔɔ rale azɛlɛ ye azo radɛnlanle aze kɛ menli a. Yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ Azuyilɛ ne rale la, bɛanwu kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛha la. Bɛanva bɛ sonla nwonane ne bɛanli gyima bieko, na bɛziale bɛhɔle anwuma kɛ anwumabɔvolɛma. Noko bɛammaa bɛ adenle bɛammaa bɛamboka Nyamenle anwumabɔvolɛ abusua ne anwo bieko. Ɔti bɛrayɛle Seetan anwumabɔvolɛma. Wɔ Baebolo ne anu bɛfɛlɛ bɛ sunsum evinli.

Akee Nyamenle manle anwoma bie dule, na azule ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsesa. Wɔ siane nnu anzi ɛlɛne ne ranwenle boka bie azo. Mekɛ dɔɔnwo zenle hɔle, na ɛnee akee menli mɔɔ wɔ ɛlɛne ne anu la kola nea alie nwo na bɛnwu awoka ne mɔ ati zo. Nzule ne hɔle zolɛ hwenle.

Akee Nowa zoanle kɔkɔsɛlɛ manle ɔvile ɛlɛne ne anu ɔvindele. Ɔtu ɔkɔ a, ɔngyɛ ɛnee yezia yera, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔnyia ɛleka kpalɛ ɔndɛnla. Ɔhɔle zolɛ ɔyɛle ɛhye na mekɛ ko biala ɔziale ɔrale, na ɛnee ɔbatɛnla ɛlɛne ne azo.

Ɛnee Nowa kpondɛ kɛ ɔnwu kɛ nzule ne ɛwie sesa bɔkɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, yemɔti ɔzoanle abubule ɔdaye noko ɔvile ɛlɛne ne anu. Abubule ne noko ziale rale ɔluakɛ yeanyia ɛleka yeandɛnla. Nowa zoanle ye mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la, na ɔvale ɔlivi nya ɔ nloa anu ɔrale. Yemɔti Nowa nwunle kɛ nzule ne ɛsesa. Nowa zoanle abubule ne mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la, na awieleɛ kolaa ne ɔnyianle azɛlɛ resee zo ɔdɛnlanle.

Akee Nyamenle dendɛle hilele Nowa. Ɔse: ‘Ɛvi ɛlɛne ne anu dwu aze. Ɛ nee wɔ abusua ne amuala yɛɛ nane ne mɔ mɔɔ boka wɔ la.’ Bɛdɛnlanle ɛlɛne ne anu mɔɔ bo ɛvolɛ ko. Yemɔti yɛkola yɛnwu kɛ bɛ nye zile liele kɛ bɛvi ɛlɛne ne anu bɛvinde mɔɔ bɛlɛ ngoane a!Mɔlebɛbo 7:10-24; 8:1-17; 1 Pita 3:19, 20. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
